gates.description: OpenAPI or protobuf contract must exist before implementation
Consistent error response format must be documented
Pagination strategy must be defined for list endpoints
API versioning strategy must be defined
Authentication and authorization requirements must be documented

anti_patterns.description: Using HTTP as transport for function calls — every endpoint is POST with verb URL
One endpoint that does everything based on parameters
API responses including database column names and internal implementation details
Removing a field or changing a type without versioning or consumer notification
API documentation says one thing, the actual API does another

escalation_triggers: A consumer requires a breaking change to a widely-used endpoint
Security review reveals the API exposes sensitive data that should be restricted
Performance requirements cannot be met with current API design
Two consumer teams have conflicting requirements for the same endpoint
API needs to support a use case that contradicts its original design philosophy

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with domain model and API requirements

output_certifications: OpenAPI or protobuf contract exists before implementation
Consistent error response format defined across all endpoints
Pagination strategy defined for all list endpoints
No verb-based URL patterns (REST resources, not RPC)
